# Pass Three — Tiferes

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos joins the newest responsive vessel with the oldest truth of the page: content first, enhancement second, one balanced revelation on Awtsmoos.com.

## Exact implementation

- `postReader.js` renders `semantic-head.html`, `reader-settings.html`, and `initial-content.html` at the route layer with resolved data.
- The shell receives only finished fragment strings and never performs SEO-critical nested includes.
- `initial-content.html` uses named locals supplied by `$ga`, escapes untrusted content, extracts readable text from `post.content` and `post.dayuh`, and emits one semantic article.
- `reader-settings.html` contains the current calm/mobile reader controls verbatim in modular non-minified form.
- The shell preserves current calm/mobile assets and inserts `postSemanticHead`, `readerSettingsHtml`, and `initialContentHtml`.
- `readerData.loadDirect()` uses the valid `series/root/post/:post` public route.

## Verification order

1. Re-read all five files.
2. Check line ceilings, tabs, JS syntax/imports, and absence of `$$sd`.
3. Confirm 8898 is still refused.
4. Start one isolated verifier on 8898.
5. Curl numeric Road raw HTML.
6. Require real title, canonical URL, H1, body text, and no template error.
7. Curl named-post raw HTML and compare identity.
8. Only after core SSR passes, continue to browser hydration and crawl discovery.
